title: 30 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL PSALM 120 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY
text: We bless you ancient of days. We bless you the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, the God of Jacob, the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps, the God who watches over Israel, the God whose eyes run to and fro across the face of the whole earth searching for someone whose heart is completely his. We bless you tonight. We honor you this morning. We celebrate you Lord. Just begin to worship him wherever you are. I don't care if you are in your room. I don't care if you are driving. I don't care if it is 3:00 a.m. and you stumbled upon this. That is not an accident. The Holy Spirit orchestrated this moment. He led you here. He brought you here because there is something he wants to do in your life that cannot wait another day. You are Yahweh. You are Yahweh. There is none beside you. You are the God who commands the morning. You are the God who tells the dawn where to begin. You are the one who holds the breath of every living creature in your hands, and tonight we surrender to you. We yield to you. Have your way, precious Holy Spirit. Shekarabashandai. Orababa shai. Koleba shandai rababa. Shekele rababa. Oro shundai koleba shandai rababa. Thank you, Lord. Thank you, Lord. Now, before we go any further, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this message right now. Don't wait until the end. Don't say I'll do it later. Do it now. Send this to someone. Post it on your status. Send it to that group chat. Send it to your family. Because the Lord is showing me that someone who needs this word is not going to find it on their own. You are the bridge. You are the instrument. God wants to use your obedience to change somebody's life tonight. There is somebody who is at the edge right now. Somebody who has been crying. Somebody who has been battling something they have not told anyone about, and this word, this prayer, this moment is is deliverance, but they need you to share it. Will you be faithful? Share it now. Hallelujah. Now, open your Bible with me. We're going to Psalm 120. Psalm 120. And I want to read verses 1 through 7, but particularly, I want us to anchor on verses 1 and 2. Psalm 120 verses 1 through 2. The Bible says, "In my distress, I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me. Deliver my soul, oh Lord, from lying lips and from a deceitful tongue." Now, sit with that for a moment. Don't rush past it. David is writing this Psalm, and the first thing he establishes is a protocol that many believers have forgotten. He says, "In my distress." He does not say in my comfort. He does not say when everything was fine. He says, "In my distress." Now, the word distress there in the Hebrew carries the idea of a tight place, a narrow confinement, a season where everything around you is pressing in. It is the picture of a man who is surrounded. The walls are closing in. Options are running out. Breath is becoming shorter. And in that place, listen to me. In that exact place of pressure, David did not run to a man. He did not call a conference. He did not post on social media looking for sympathy. The Bible says he cried unto the Lord. And here is the revelation. The Lord heard him. Now, I want to talk to somebody tonight. I want to talk to somebody this morning. You have been in a place of distress. You have been in a season where it seems like the heavens are brass. Where it seems like your prayers are bouncing off the ceiling and falling back to the ground. Where you have done everything you know to do. You have fasted. You have prayed. You have sown. You have confessed. You have declared. And yet the situation has not moved. And the enemy has been whispering to you, "God has forgotten you. God is not listening. God has moved on to somebody else. I came to tell you that is a lie from the pit of hell. The Bible is very clear. Isaiah chapter 49:14-16. Zion said, "The Lord has forsaken me, my Lord has forgotten me." And God responded, oh I love this. God responded and said, "Can a woman forget her nursing child that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee. Behold, I have engraved thee upon the palms of my hands. Thy walls are continually before me." Your walls are continually before him. Your situation is continually before him. Your marriage is continually before him. Your health is continually before him. Your finances are continually before him. Your children are continually before him. He has not looked away. He has not blinked. He has not turned his attention elsewhere. You are engraved, not written, not painted, engraved upon the palms of his hands. Now listen carefully. There are dimensions to Psalm 120 that many people do not teach. This Psalm is the first of what we call the songs of ascent. Psalms 120 through 134. These were the songs that the Israelites would sing as they were going up to Jerusalem for the great feasts. They were pilgrimage songs, songs of the journey upward. And the fact that Psalm 120 begins with distress is not a mistake. It is a prophetic pattern. God is saying to you tonight, your journey upward begins in the place of distress. Your elevation begins at the point of your greatest pressure. The very thing the enemy meant to use to crush you is the launching pad that God is about to use to catapult you into your next season. Genesis chapter 50:20, "But as for you, you thought evil against me but God meant it on to good to bring to pass as it is this day to save much people alive. What the enemy designed as your burial, God is redesigning as your breakthrough. I decree and declare over your life right now. The distress you are in is not your destination. It is your departure gate. You are about to take off. You are about to be launched. You are about to enter a dimension of glory and favor and supernatural acceleration that your enemies never calculated. Somebody say amen. Now look at verse two again. David says deliver my soul oh Lord from lying lips and from a deceitful tongue. Now this is where it gets deep. David is not just talking about gossip. He's not just talking about people who tell lies. David is addressing something far more sinister. He's talking about spiritual utterances. He's talking about incantations. He's talking about words that have been spoken in the realm of the spirit against your destiny, against your progress, against your health, against your marriage, against your children, against your calling. In the realm of the spirit, words carry power. Proverbs 18:21, death and life are in the power of the tongue and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof. Words are not just sound waves. Words are spiritual containers. They carry either life or death, blessing or curse, promotion or demotion. And there are tongues, lying lips, deceitful tongues that have been speaking against you in the spirit realm at altars, in covens, in dark places where names are called at midnight, where your picture is placed on altars, where your name is being chanted, where declarations are being made over your destiny that say you will not rise, you will not marry, you will not conceive, you will not prosper, you will not succeed, you will not fulfill purpose. And David by the inspiration of the Holy Ghost said, "Lord, deliver my soul from these tongues." I want you to hear me very clearly tonight. This is not just a teaching, this is not just a Bible study, this is a confrontation. We are about to confront every tongue, every lying lip, every deceitful tongue, every altar, every incantation, every enchantment, every divination, every sorcery, every witchcraft projection that has been speaking against your life, and we are about to silence them by the blood of the lamb and by the word of our testimony. Thus said the spirit of God, "There is someone listening to me right now, and the Lord is telling me that the delay in your life is not natural. It is sponsored, it is organized. It is orchestrated from the kingdom of darkness. There is a tongue somewhere that has been speaking against your advancement. Every time you get to the edge of your breakthrough, something pulls you back. Every time the door is about to open, something slams it shut. Every time the contract is about to be signed, something disrupts it, and you have been wondering, 'What is wrong with me? Why does this keep happening?' It is not you, it is a tongue, and tonight that tongue is being cut off in the name of Jesus. Isaiah chapter 54 verse 17. Write this down, memorize it, let it become the breath of your spirit. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. Did you hear that? Every tongue, every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you have the covenant right to condemn. You have the legal backing of heaven to silence it. You have the authority of the name of Jesus to shut it down. Now, Psalm 120:3 says, "What shall be given unto thee? Or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?" In other words, David is now prophesying judgment over the tongue that has been speaking against him, and verse four says, "Sharp arrows of the mighty with coals of juniper." Listen to that. God's response to the lying tongue is sharp arrows and burning coals. God does not take it lightly when the enemy speaks against his children. Numbers chapter 23:23 says, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel." Why? Because the Lord his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them. Tonight, the shout of the king is among us, and every enchantment breaks. Every divination is nullified. Every incantation returns to sender. Every curse spoken at midnight is reversed by the blood of the lamb. I want to pray now, and I don't want you to pray casually. I want you to pray with everything in you. Open your mouth, lift your voice. If you are in a place where you can shout, shout. If you are in a place where you can cry, cry, but do not be silent. This is not the time for silence. This is the time for warfare. The Bible says in Joel chapter 3:10, "Let the weak say, I am strong." It doesn't matter how you feel, it doesn't matter what the circumstances look like. Open your mouth and declare the word of the Lord over your life. Are you ready? Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace tonight. I come boldly, not because of my righteousness, but because of the blood of Jesus that speaks better things than the blood of Abel. I come carrying the lives, the destinies, the situations, the families, the marriages, the businesses, the ministries of everyone under the sound of my voice. And I stand in the gap according to Ezekiel chapter 22 verse 30, and I say, "Lord, hear us tonight." Father, the first thing I pray is that you open every blocked ear in the spirit. Every ear that the enemy has sealed, every ear that religion has closed, every ear that disappointment has shut. I pray according to Isaiah chapter 50 verse 4 through 5, that you awaken the ear to hear as the learned. Open their spiritual ears tonight, Lord, that this word will not fall to the ground. That this word will enter into their spirit like a seed entering fertile soil and produce a harvest of righteousness, breakthrough, and testimony. In Jesus' name. Now, I speak to every life under the sound of my voice. I speak to your spirit man right now. Wake up. Wake up. Wake up. Ephesians chapter 5 verse 14, "Awake thou that sleepest and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light." I command your spirit to come alive. Every dormant gift, wake up. Every dormant calling, wake up. Every dormant promise that God spoke over your life in years past that you have given up on, wake up. Wake up in the name of Jesus. I speak to your morning. I speak [music] to the dawn of this new day that God is giving you. I declare that this day will not be like the days before it. Lamentations chapter 3 verses 22 through 23, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." Father, let new mercy find them this morning. Let new grace locate them. Let new favor rest upon them. Let new doors open before them. Let new connections be established. Let new resources flow in their direction. Everything that was stagnant, I command it to move. Everything that was delayed, I command it to accelerate. Everything that was stolen, I command a sevenfold restoration according to Proverbs chapter 6:31. Now, listen to me. I am going into offer a prayer now, and I need you to pray with me like your life depends on it, because in some cases it does. Every lying lip that has been speaking against your destiny, I silence you now in the name of Jesus. Every deceitful tongue that has been making declarations against your marriage, I cut you off by the sword of the spirit. Every mouth that has been cursing you in secret, every mouth that has been calling your name at altars of darkness, every mouth that has been pronouncing failure and barrenness and poverty and sickness over your life, I decree and declare you are silenced, you are muzzled, you are shut down permanently by the blood of the lamb. I speak to every evil altar that has been erected against your life. Whether it was erected by your family, by your village, by your community, by envious colleagues, by jealous neighbors, by wicked in-laws, by agents of darkness who have taken assignment against your star, I speak to that altar right now. Catch fire. [music] Catch fire. Catch fire in the name of Jesus. Every sacrifice that has been offered on that altar against your progress, I command it to be consumed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every covenant that was sealed at that altar, I break it now by the blood of Jesus. Shekaraba shandai orababa koleba shantai rababa oshandai kolema shantai rababa shekele The blood speaks. The blood of Jesus speaks. The blood of Jesus speaks. It speaks better things. It speaks mercy. It speaks deliverance. It speaks healing. It speaks restoration. It speaks open doors. It speaks fruitfulness. It speaks long life. The blood speaks tonight over your life. I come against every spirit of delay that has been attached to your destiny. Every spirit that has been responsible for near success syndrome. You get close, but you never touch it. You see it, but you never hold it. You are promised, but it never materializes. That spirit of delay, I bind you now. I cast you out in the name of Jesus. You will no longer operate in this person's life. Your assignment is terminated. Your lease is expired. Your time is up. Get out in the name of Jesus. Romans chapter 8 verse 1. There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the spirit. I declare there is no condemnation over your life. Whatever guilt the enemy has been using to keep you in bondage, whatever shame from your past that has been a chain around your neck, whatever mistakes you made years ago that the accuser keeps replaying in your mind at 2:00 a.m. when you cannot sleep, I declare tonight the blood of Jesus has washed it away. It is gone. It is finished. The record has been expunged. Heaven's court has acquitted you. You are free. I pray for someone right now whose body has been under attack. The doctors have given a report, but I have come with a different report. Isaiah chapter 53 verse 5. But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him, and with his stripes we are we are I speak to that body right now. I speak to every organ that is malfunctioning. I speak to every cell that is under attack. I speak to that kidney. I speak to that liver. I speak to that womb. I speak to that heart. I speak to that brain. I speak to those lungs. I command healing in the name of Jesus. I command restoration in the name of Jesus. I command wholeness in the name of Jesus. Every growth that does not belong, I command it to wither and die like the fig tree in Mark chapter 11. Every infection that has refused to respond to treatment, I command the healing virtue of Jesus Christ to flush it out now. Every diagnosis of cancer, of fibroid, of tumor, of diabetes, of hypertension, of HIV, of lupus, of endometriosis, of PCOS, of kidney failure, I speak the word of the Lord over you tonight. You are healed. Not you will be healed, you are healed. By his stripes you were healed. It is a finished work. Receive it now. Somebody say I receive my healing. Now I am moving into the area of finances. Oh, hallelujah. Deuteronomy chapter 8 verse 18, but thou shall remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day. Father, I release the power to get wealth into the lives of everyone listening. I command financial gates to open. I command economic doors to swing wide. I command resources to flow from the north, from the south, from the east, from the west. I decree that poverty is broken. I decree that lack is broken. I decree that financial embarrassment is broken. I decree that debt is canceled. I speak to that business that has been struggling. I speak life into it. I speak customers into it. I speak contracts into it. I speak investors into it. I speak profitability into it. I speak growth into it in the name of Jesus. I speak to that job search that has been yielding nothing. I command the right doors to open. I command the right connections to be made. I command favor with the people who have the power to hire you. I command supernatural positioning. You will not beg for bread. Your children will not beg. Psalm 37:25, "I have been young and now I'm old, yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken nor his seed begging bread." Every financial embargo placed upon your life by any power, by any principality, by any authority of darkness, I break it now. I shatter it now. I dismantle it now in the name of Jesus. Every ancestral cause of poverty that has been running in your bloodline, every pattern of almost but not quite that has been repeating from generation to generation, the blood of Jesus terminates it tonight. You are the generation that breaks the cycle. You are the one who steps into a new financial dimension. The wealth of the sinner that has been laid up for the just, I command it to begin transferring into your hands now. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Oh, the spirit of God is moving. Someone under the sound of my voice, your name is Grace. Or the name Grace is significant around you. The Lord says he has seen your tears. He has collected every one of them in his bottle according to Psalm 56:8. The season of weeping is over. Joy is not coming. Joy has arrived. This week you will laugh. This month, you will testify. That situation that has kept you up at night, the Lord says, "I am resolving it myself. Take your hands off it. Let me be God over it." There is a man listening to me and the name sounds like Daniel or Emmanuel. The Lord is saying that the business idea you have been sitting on, it is from him. Do not let fear rob you of your harvest. The Lord says, "Step out. I will fund it. I will protect it. I will multiply it." Proverbs chapter 16 verse 3, "Commit thy works unto the Lord and thy thoughts shall be established." The Lord says to commit it to him and move. I speak to someone who has been dealing with marriage delay. You have been believing God for a spouse. Year after year, the promise seems to stretch further away. Relationships have come and gone. Engagements have broken. Expectations have been disappointed. And the enemy has been telling you that you will grow old alone. That nobody wants you. That there is something wrong with you. I rebuke that lie in the name of Jesus. Genesis chapter 2 verse 18, "And the Lord God said, 'It is not good that the man should be alone. I will make him an helpmeet for him.'" If God said it is not good for you to be alone, then he has already prepared someone for you. I decree that the veil is removed. Whatever has been blocking your marital destiny, I tear it down tonight. Every monitoring spirit that has been scaring away your helpers, I bind you and I cast you out. Every spiritual husband, every spiritual wife, every marine spirit, every incubus, every succubus that has been claiming ownership of your body and your destiny, I divorce you by the blood of Jesus. The marriage certificate that was written in the underworld is torn to pieces tonight. You are free. You are released. And your earthly spouse is being released to find you. The connection will happen. The meeting will take place. and it will not be by your own wisdom. It will be the Lord's doing >> [music] >> and it will be marvelous in your eyes. Psalm 118:23. Somebody shout hallelujah right there. Now, I am praying for families. I am praying for bloodlines. I am praying for generations. Exodus chapter 20:5 talks about generational iniquity, the sins of the fathers visiting the children to the third and fourth generation. But, listen to me. That is the old covenant pattern. Under the new covenant, Ezekiel chapter 18:20 says, "The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father." So, I stand on the authority of the new covenant tonight, sealed by the blood of Jesus, and I break every generational pattern over your family. Every pattern of premature death broken. Every pattern of divorce broken. Every pattern of mental illness broken. Every pattern of addiction broken. Every pattern of failure at the edge of breakthrough broken. Every pattern of poverty broken. Every pattern of childlessness broken. Every generational chain that has kept your family in a cycle of defeat, I declare the cycle ends tonight. A new pattern begins. A pattern of success, a pattern of prosperity, a pattern of health, a pattern of longevity, a pattern of divine favor. It starts with you and it flows down to your children and your children's children. I speak to the children now. I speak to the children of everyone praying with me. Psalm 127:3-5 says that children are a heritage of the Lord and the fruit of the womb is his reward. I declare that your children will not be casualties of the kingdom of darkness. Your children will not be claimed by the spirit of the age. Your children will not be taken by drugs, by gangs, by perversion, by depression, by suicide. I place the blood of Jesus over every child connected to this prayer. I assign angels of protection according to Matthew chapter 18:10, their angels do always behold the face of the Father. I decree wisdom upon them. I decree discernment upon them. I decree divine purpose upon them. They will serve God. They will fulfill destiny. They will become great in the earth. The fire of God is moving right now. I can feel it in my spirit. Something is breaking. Something is shifting. Something is opening in the realm of the spirit. There is someone you have been having strange dreams. You have been dreaming of eating in the dream, of being chased, of swimming in water, of seeing snakes, of finding yourself in your village, in your old school, in old houses, of seeing dead relatives. These are not ordinary dreams. These are spiritual attacks, and tonight I sever the connection. Every dream portal that the enemy has been using to attack you, I shut it down by the blood of Jesus. Every spiritual feeding that has taken place in the dream, I command your body to vomit it out now in the name of Jesus. Every poison that was deposited, every tracker that was planted, every cage that was built around you in the dream world, I set fire to it now. You will sleep, and your sleep will be sweet. Proverbs chapter 3:24, "When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid. Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet." Peaceful sleep is your portion. Revelatory dreams from the Holy Spirit are your inheritance. The enemy's access to your dream life is permanently revoked starting tonight. I speak to witchcraft. Every witchcraft power that has been assigned against you whether from your family, from your workplace, from your neighborhood, from your church, I confront you now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Acts chapter 13 verses 9 through 11. Just as Paul confronted Elymas the sorcerer and said, "O full of all subtlety and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, will thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?" I speak to every agent of darkness that has been perverting your ways. The hand of the Lord is against you. The judgment of God falls upon every witchcraft operation tonight. Every cauldron that is cooking your destiny, I overturn it by fire. Every mirror that is being used to monitor your movements, I shatter it by the blood of Jesus. Every effigy, every doll, every representation of your life that is being manipulated, I command it to catch fire and burn to ashes. You are no longer accessible to the kingdom of darkness. You are hidden with Christ in God. Colossians chapter 3 verse 3. Oh, hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am praying now for restoration. Joel chapter 2 verse 25. And I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you. Father, I ask for supernatural restoration over every life connected to this prayer. Restore wasted years. Restore stolen opportunities. Restore broken relationships that were supposed to be blessings. Restore health that was taken. Restore finances that were devoured. Restore joy that was stolen. Restore peace that was disrupted. Restore vision that was dimmed. Restore faith that was shattered. Let the God of restoration arise tonight and let every devourer be rebuked according to Malachi chapter 3 verse 11. I decree that God is accelerating your timeline. What should have taken 10 years, God is doing in one. What should have taken five years, God is doing in a month. What should have taken a year, God is doing this week. Supernatural acceleration is released upon your life. The slow season is over. The waiting season has served its purpose. Now comes the suddenly of God. Acts chapter 2 verse 2. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind. The suddenly of God is hitting your life right now. Someone Esther or something connected to the name Esther, the Lord says for such a time as this. He says you have been wondering why you went through what you went through. He says the pain was not pointless. The rejection was not random. The betrayal was not without purpose. He was positioning you. He was preparing you. And now the moment has come. The moment you were born for. The platform is being set. The door is being opened. Do not shrink back. Do not let the memory of the pain make you afraid of the promotion. Step into it. It is your time. And there is someone whose name begins with J, Joseph or John or Josephine or Joy. The Lord is saying that what was meant to destroy you has qualified you. Like Joseph who went from the pits to the prison to the palace, your story is not over. The last chapter has not been written. The palace awaits. The throne awaits. The position of influence awaits. And every person who threw you into the pit will come and bow before the blessing that God places on your life. Not because you demanded it, but because God vindicated you. Romans chapter 12:19, "Vengeance is mine. I will repay, saith the Lord." Father, we thank you. We give you glory. We give you honor. We give you praise. I am sealing this prayer now in the name of Jesus. I speak over the remainder of this month. I speak over this week. I speak over the days ahead. I decree that this week is your week of testimony. You will call your family with good news. You will send a message in your group chat that starts with guess what God did. Healing that was gradual is becoming complete this week. Relationships that were strained are being restored this week. I decree that the siege over your finances is over. The siege over your health is over. The siege over your marriage is over. The siege over your career is over.
